title: InspectorManifest
description: Provenance manifest produced by the Inspector role. Links every claim in report.md back to its upstream evidence (code line or source URL). Written to narrative-output/inspector.json.

dataset.description: Path or name of the source dataset

roles.description: Artifact file paths produced by each upstream role

claims.description: One entry per verifiable claim or key sentence in report.md.

text.description: Exact sentence or phrase from report.md that is being grounded

evidence_type.description: code = produced by Analyst script; reference = from Detective source URL; both = backed by both

evidence.description: At least one of code or reference must be present, matching evidence_type

code.description: Pointer to the Analyst script line that produced this number or finding

script.description: Relative path to the Python script inside narrative-output/analyst/

line_start.description: 1-based line where the result is computed

line_end.description: 1-based last line of the relevant block (inclusive)

result_variable.description: Variable name that holds the reported value

reference.description: Pointer to a Detective-sourced external reference

url.description: Source URL fetched by the Detective

excerpt.description: Relevant passage from the source that supports the claim

verified.description: null = not yet verified; true/false set by verify_claims.py

verify_note.description: Populated by verify_claims.py — reason for pass or failure

summary.description: Verification summary. Populated by verify_claims.py after a --verify run.
